cachingEnabled.description: This is the flag to toggle voice caching for the assistant.

provider.description: This is the voice provider that will be used.

model.description: This is the model that will be used.

voiceId.description: The ID of the particular voice you want to use.

isCustomHumeVoice.description: Indicates whether the chosen voice is a preset Hume AI voice or a custom voice.

chunkPlan.description: This is the plan for chunking the model output before it is sent to the voice provider.

description.description:
Natural language instructions describing how the synthesized speech should sound, including but not limited to tone, intonation, pacing, and accent (e.g., 'a soft, gentle voice with a strong British accent').

If a Voice is specified in the request, this description serves as acting instructions.
If no Voice is specified, a new voice is generated based on this description.

fallbackPlan.description: This is the plan for voice provider fallbacks in the event that the primary voice provider fails.
